title: Model Comparison
description: Compare XGBoost model versions across recordings, preprocessing settings, and window sizes. Data source: inference_log (replay rows only).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' AND fall_detected = true
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_version) AS value FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT participant) AS value FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay'

panels.title: Fall Detection Rate by Model  (% of windows flagged as fall)
panels.description: Higher is not always better â€” compare against ground truth. A model that fires too often may have many false positives.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS fall_rate_pct FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: Average Latency by Model  (ms per window)
panels.description: Average inference pipeline time including resampling, feature extraction and XGBoost prediction.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS avg_ms, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS p95_ms FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: Confidence Distribution by Model  (percentiles)
panels.description: A healthy model has predictions clustered near 0 (clear negative) and 1 (clear fall). Median near 0.5 signals uncertainty / possible drift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, COUNT(*) AS predictions, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence)::numeric, 3) AS p10, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence)::numeric, 3) AS p25, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence)::numeric, 3) AS median, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence)::numeric, 3) AS p75, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence)::numeric, 3) AS p90, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) AS mean, ROUND(STDDEV(confidence)::numeric, 3) AS std_dev FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: Uncertainty Ratio by Model  (% of predictions in 0.4â€“0.6 confidence band)
panels.description: Predictions near the 0.5 decision boundary â€” the model is unsure. High uncertainty ratio may indicate poor feature separability or distribution shift. Target: < 10%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.6) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS uncertain_pct, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence > 0.8) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS high_conf_pct, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence < 0.2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS clear_neg_pct FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: Fall Rate by Resampling Method
panels.description: Does the resampling method affect detection results? Run replay with different resampling settings (operator dashboard â†’ Processing Configuration) to populate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(resampling_method, 'unknown') AS resampling_method, model_version, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS fall_rate_pct, COUNT(*) AS total_windows FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY resampling_method, model_version ORDER BY resampling_method, model_version

panels.title: Per-Recording Comparison  (same file, different settings)
panels.description: Key comparison table. Each row is one (recording Ã— model Ã— window Ã— step Ã— resampling Ã— sensor) combination. Compare fall_rate and avg_fall_confidence to isolate the effect of each variable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT participant AS recording_file, model_version, ROUND(window_size::numeric / 50, 1) AS window_s, step_seconds, COALESCE(resampling_method, 'unknown') AS resampling, COALESCE(acc_sensor_type, 'unknown') AS sensor, COUNT(*) AS total_windows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) AS falls_detected, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS fall_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fall_detected THEN confidence END)::numeric, 3) AS avg_fall_confidence, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT fall_detected THEN confidence END)::numeric, 3) AS avg_no_fall_conf, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS avg_latency_ms, MAX(timestamp) AS last_run FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY participant, model_version, window_size, step_seconds, resampling_method, acc_sensor_type ORDER BY participant, model_version, window_size

panels.title: Window Size vs Fall Rate
panels.description: Does a longer detection window improve accuracy? Run the same recording with different window sizes via the operator dashboard config to populate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(window_size::numeric / 50, 1) AS window_seconds, window_size AS window_samples, step_seconds, model_version, COUNT(*) AS total_windows, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS fall_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY window_size, step_seconds, model_version ORDER BY window_size, model_version

panels.title: Sensor Type vs Fall Rate
panels.description: Does the accelerometer sensor type (Bosch vs Non-Bosch) affect detection? Run the same recording with different sensor type settings to compare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(acc_sensor_type, 'unknown') AS acc_sensor_type, model_version, COUNT(*) AS total_windows, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS fall_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS avg_latency_ms FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY acc_sensor_type, model_version ORDER BY acc_sensor_type, model_version

panels.title: Replay History  (most recent runs)
panels.description: Chronological log of all replay runs including all settings used. Use this to track which experiments have been run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', timestamp) AS run_time, participant AS file, model_version, ROUND(window_size::numeric / 50, 1) AS window_s, step_seconds, COALESCE(resampling_method, 'unknown') AS resampling, COALESCE(acc_sensor_type, 'unknown') AS sensor, COUNT(*) AS windows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_detected) AS falls FROM inference_log WHERE inference_mode = 'replay' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('minute', timestamp), participant, model_version, window_size, step_seconds, resampling_method, acc_sensor_type ORDER BY run_time DESC LIMIT 50
